name: Yurine ~Onee-sama ga Oshiete Kureta~
original_name: ゆりね ～おねえさまがおしえてくれた～
source:
One day, the protagonist's older sister died. Upon hearing this, his mother went mad and began referring to the protagonist by his sister's name, "Natsuki." The protagonist slowly accepted this role to make his mother happy. His mother even went as far as to enroll him in the school she used to go to, Momoyuri Academy-- an all-girls school.

Momoyuri Academy is a famously prestigious school, where the daughters of company directors, politicians, bureaucrats and the like attend. Within the student body lies the descendent of the Kamikura zaibatsu, Kamikura Sayaka. A graceful young lady excelling in schoolwork and sports, Sayaka is the object of every student's admiration, including those of the so-called "Natsuki."

A few months after Natsuki transferred to Momoyuri Academy, his secret came out to his beloved Sayaka that he's a boy. Natsuki began to panic, but Sayaka promised not to tell, as long as he would do everything she said, starting with calling her "Onee-sama." 

Before he knew it, Natsuki was caught up in Sayaka's orders...

[translated from official site]
translation:
某天，主角的姊姊去世了。母親聽到消息後精神失常，開始用姊姊的名字「奈月」稱呼主角。為了讓母親開心，主角慢慢接受了這個身分。母親甚至讓他進入姊姊曾經就讀的學校——女子學校桃百合學園。

桃百合學園是一所著名的貴族學校，企業董事、政治家和官僚等名流的女兒都在這裡就讀。學生中有神倉財閥的後人神倉紗耶香。紗耶香舉止優雅，文武雙全，是包括所謂「奈月」在內的所有學生憧憬的對象。

奈月轉入桃百合學園幾個月後，深愛的紗耶香發現了他其實是男生的秘密。奈月驚慌失措，紗耶香卻答應保守秘密，條件是他必須服從自己的一切命令，第一件事便是稱她為「姊姊大人」。

不知不覺間，奈月已經深陷紗耶香的命令之中……
